g.text: The vast majority of turbine-governor models have mwbase as a parameter.

text.style: font-family:'Lucida Sans Unicode','Lucida Grande','DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:0; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; fill:#3C3C3C;fill-opacity:1.00; stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:0.00; stroke-width:0; white-space: pre;

g.text: The parameter is specified explicitly in the turbine-governor models to support

text.style: font-family:'Lucida Sans Unicode','Lucida Grande','DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:0; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; fill:#3C3C3C;fill-opacity:1.00; stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:0.00; stroke-width:0; white-space: pre;

g.text: use of a different value by transient analysis tools, if needed. If this parameter

text.style: font-family:'Lucida Sans Unicode','Lucida Grande','DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:0; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; fill:#3C3C3C;fill-opacity:1.00; stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:0.00; stroke-width:0; white-space: pre;

g.text: is present it shall correspond to RotatingMachine.ratedPowerFactor *

text.style: font-family:'Lucida Sans Unicode','Lucida Grande','DejaVu Sans',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:0; font-style:normal; font-size:10px; fill:#3C3C3C;fill-opacity:1.00; stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:0.00; stroke-width:0; white-space: pre;

g.text: RotatingMachine.ratedS. In case mwbase is not provided or the value is set to 0
